qualifications: Three sequential pairs per device, without an A/A noise distribution; no population performance or thermal-stability inference.

Analyze within each phone. Android uses Maestro and one excluded full conditioning tour; iPhone uses WDA with settled player/editor setup and one excluded setup swipe. Do not pool cross-device CPU or absolute latencies.
Peak RSS is an absolute process lifetime high-water value including setup/conditioning, not RSS growth or total GPU-driver footprint. Android uses VmHWM; iPhone uses Darwin ru_maxrss.

GPU-ready callback and guarded full-art RAF values are proxies, not physical scanout, gesture completion, or first PNG-bridge visibility. Warm callback figures are means over 10 swipe or 8 editor ready events; they are not P95.
CPU segments include the driven UI, accessibility and settling workload, not isolated rendering CPU.
Baseline API3 fields retain viewport size; API4 candidate fields use native resolution. Atlas pixel payloads exclude native alignment and other allocations, and are not aggregate GPU residency.
Ordinary primary preparation is not a verified prebuilt source. No forced geometry probe ran in the primary members.
Startup/photo diagnostic failures, the iOS allocation failure, the stopped Android sourceRef admission, and recorder failures are excluded and retained separately.
instrumentationAndFixtureScope: Identical primary instrumentation433 and frozen synthetic replay357 fixture5dc on both sources; each platform has its own matched signed artifact and UI driver. No raw identifiers or account data are included.
